QUOTE: the defaults become `platform_calloc_uninit` (always returns NULL) and `platform_free_uninit` (does nothing), so an unconfigured build fails allocations cleanly rather than linking against `calloc`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that under NO_STD_FUNCTIONS the default pointers are an uninit calloc that always returns NULL and an uninit free that does nothing, so allocations fail instead of falling back.
